title: alpha.project/1
description: Project entity — not a folder. Links to Drive path prefixes and optional mail/site.

description.description: Single long-form project description (no separate body field).

status.description: Optional persisted hint; Admin derives display status from linked tasks.

icon.description: Optional override emoji/image. When unset, UI inherits the primary enterprise icon.

primary_enterprise_id.description: Primary farm enterprise this project belongs to (required in practice). Planning groups by this; icon inherits from that enterprise.

enterprise_ids.description: All enterprises this project touches; must include primary_enterprise_id when set. Extra ids are secondary memberships.

depends_on.description: Other project ids this project depends on (Planning links)

drive.description: Path prefixes inside the Space Drive this Project uses
